proposals.title: Proposal Requesting a Report Regarding Direct and Indirect Political Expenditures
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research (NCPPR)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing lobbying policies, direct and indirect lobbying payments, grassroots lobbying communications, trade association model-legislation payments, and oversight decision-making.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
